migration.rehearsal: Applied expansion in explicit transaction, rolled back, verified command_receipts absent.

evidence: One team and creator membership, one receipt, one audit/history and one outbox event on retry.
Original result returned after ordinary replay and real child-process response loss after COMMIT.
Changed input returns typed key reuse conflict without additional writes.
Agent capability changed-input replay returns IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT.
Faults before mutation, after mutation, during outbox encoding and at deferred COMMIT leave zero business/receipt/audit/outbox writes.
Two independent Bun processes using the actual staging application login compete with an observed PostgreSQL lock wait; waiter replays the owner result.
SIGKILL of the mutation owner rolls back its transaction and permits the waiting process to commit one effect.
Agent approval consumption, business update, receipt, audit and outbox roll back together after approval consumption and at COMMIT; retry consumes once.
Live role/private-team membership, workspace membership, credential enabled/expiry/scopes, session and run state checked before replay.
Actual concurrent membership deletion waits for an in-flight authorized command, then subsequent replay is denied.
No business effect is repeated after revocation.

changedFileLint.notes: Three pre-existing async fixture-store warnings, one pre-existing gateway-test async warning, and three defensive teardown/rejected callback warnings in the new PostgreSQL suite.

validation.schemaDrift: drizzle-kit generate reports no schema changes

coverage: Canonical input hashes with nested object key order and JSON validation.
Expired legacy API and agent receipts preserve identity and either return an authorized original success or require reconciliation.
Redacted result tombstones reject replay without repeating effects.
Database rejects incomplete command commits, rewritten identity/completed results and cross-workspace event links.
limits: No production database migration, deployment or connection-pointer change.

Enabled keyed adapters: public API team creation and the registered SQL agent teams.update capability. HTTP PATCH/DELETE keep existing contracts; future keyed domain commands must adopt the shared executor.
Operator reconciliation is required for unprovable legacy outcomes; they are not automatically re-executed.
Production rollout requires quiescing legacy separate-step writers; rollback must retain expansion/evidence and disable affected writes.
